chunks: We sent Noah to his people. He said: "O my people, worship God, for you have no other god but He. Will you not take heed for yourselves?"
ai.seo_question: What was the main message Prophet Noah (AS) conveyed to his people according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the foundational role of Noah (AS) as the first major prophet sent to establish pure monotheism, serving as a precedent for the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) mission. The call to 'fear Allah' (Taqwa) is interpreted not merely as fear of punishment, but as a conscious awareness of divine presence that guides ethical conduct, a concept deeply emphasized in the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings. This narrative underscores the continuity of the prophetic message across generations, reinforcing the unity of the core Islamic creed.
